craft_evidence.owned: no owned facility claimed; most of the range is stated 'Made in New York' (maker not named); 'responsible manufacturing' on the about page
craft_evidence.mills: no ('European Flax certified' linen on one skirt; no mill)
craft_evidence.madein: 100% (80 of 80 sampled: New York 50, Italy 14, Portugal 9, Morocco 6, Bulgaria 1)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — launched 2012 by Daniella Kallmeyer; Lower East Side flagship opened 2019
craft_evidence.reasoning: Every product page states where it was made, and most of the range says New York, with knits from Italy, denim from Portugal and leather from Morocco. No factory, maker or mill is named and the brand owns no making. A complete, specific country-and-city statement is still a 2; naming the New York makers would make it a 3.
